name: Token Multirrede
description: TMR (Token Multirrede) is a TRC-20 token on Tron with a SunSwap V4 USDT pool set up to trade at about US$1 per TMR (0.01% fee). Buyers pay ~US$1.0001 per TMR; sellers receive the USDT held in the pool at ~US$1, only while there is USDT in the pool. Not a stablecoin: no backing outside the pool and no promised returns. The issuer holds ~50% of the supply plus the liquidity positions. The contract has no blacklist, freeze, pause or transfer tax; supply is at its cap. Details and risks in the whitepaper.
